basic_profile.bio: I am a 23-year-old female working at a doctor's office in a small town in Oregon. My interests include understanding healthcare better, exploring video game mods, and occasionally watching drama unfold online. I enjoy learning about both modern and alternative medicine. In my free time, I like to unwind with video games, especially the GTA series. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my cat, Luna.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of medical procedures and healthcare practices, gained from my job at a doctor's office. I also have a growing interest in video game modding, specifically for the GTA series, which I explore during my free time.
